overview_description.description: OneCLI prevents agents from directly accessing raw API keys and authentication tokens by replacing them with managed placeholder values that are injected securely during data transmission. Through centralized control policies, the software enforces data restrictions, blocks specific endpoint paths, applies rate limits, and requires human approval for sensitive digital operations. By governing tool calls, command-line interfaces, data transfers, and agent-generated scripts outside the large language model environment, the system mitigates credential exposure and halts unauthorized actions.
